title: Describing a project by its result, not by the technology used

videos.script: Look at how most people describe a project on a CV. Developed a web application using Python, Flask, SQLite and Docker. {{usual}} That sentence would fit ten thousand CVs. It says what you used, and the reader wanted to know what you did. {{fit}} The other way round is one line that says what the thing does for somebody, and how anybody could check. The technology comes last, and small. {{other}} This lesson rewrites loanbook's line that way, gives you a pattern for your own, and deals with the part people get wrong next: numbers that are not true.
